page_title: WOL 3-0 LEI | Wolves v Leicester 26/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' The ball spins to Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) on the edge of the box. He hits across the ball and sends it goalwards, but it goes just wide of the left post.
90+4' Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves) smashes the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after going way off target.
90+3' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) launches a cross from the corner, but Jose Sa is alert to thwart the effort.
90+2' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Wolves force their opponents to concede a corner.
90' He should have scored! Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
89' Substitution. Carlos Forbs (Wolves) replaces Matheus Cunha.
89' Vitor Pereira has decided to make a change. Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) replaces Nelson Semedo.
88' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
85' 3 - 0 Goal! Matheus Cunha pulls the ball back for Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) on the edge of the box, and he beats the keeper with a fine strike into the bottom left corner. 3:0.
84' Santiago Bueno (Wolves) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Matt Doherty.
84' Vitor Pereira has decided to substitute Andre and he is replaced by Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves).
83' Substitution. Bilal El Khannouss leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jeremy Monga (Leicester).
82' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
81' Oliver Skipp (Leicester) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
80' Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.
79' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul after Oliver Skipp (Leicester) hacks down one of his opponents.
77' Here is a change. Jorgen Strand Larsen is going off and Vitor Pereira gives the last tactical orders to Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves).
77' Substitution. Rayan Ait Nouri is replaced by Pablo Sarabia (Wolves).
75' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
72' Penalty saved! Jamie Vardy (Leicester) sends the penalty towards the bottom left corner, but Jose Sa pulls off a wonderful save to deny him.
71' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
71' Referee Samuel Barrott is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Leicester!
70' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Leicester as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
69' The referee gives a penalty kick to Leicester!!
68' Conor Coady (Leicester) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
65' Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
64' A shot from the edge of the box by Oliver Skipp (Leicester) is a waste and goes well wide of the right post.
61' Samuel Barrott shows a yellow card to Kasey McAteer (Leicester) for his blatant foul.
58' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
56' 2 - 0 Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike, which goes inside the left post.
55' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!

55' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Wolves are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
52' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker over the bar.
48' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Wout Faes (Leicester) gets booked.
46' Ruud van Nistelrooy has made a change at the break. Oliver Skipp (Leicester) has come on in place of Boubakary Soumare.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Facundo Buonanotte is replaced by Kasey McAteer (Leicester).
46' Half-time substitution. Ruud van Nistelrooy decided to make a change. Ricardo Pereira is replaced by James Justin (Leicester).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+7' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Wonderful movement by Wolves. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
45+1' Problems for Ruud van Nistelrooy as Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Leicester) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Jordan Ayew replaces him.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Leicester) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
43' Wolves take a short corner kick.
43' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
42' The corner is swung in but Wolves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
42' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
41' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Samuel Barrott has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
37' Golden chance! Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
33' 1 - 0 Goal! Rayan Ait Nouri manages to prod the ball to Matheus Cunha (Wolves) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
31' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Leicester) picks up a long through ball, but Jose Sa deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
29' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) controls a cross inside the box and sends a shot towards the right post, but one of the defenders reacts superbly to block his effort.
27' The shot by Matheus Cunha (Wolves) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Mads Hermansen.
25' Boubakary Soumare (Leicester) is penalised for holding. Samuel Barrott signals a set piece.
23' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester).
23' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
21' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
18' Conor Coady (Leicester) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
18' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
16' Toti (Wolves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Samuel Barrott had an easy-decision to make.
11' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
10' Andre (Wolves) sends a first-time strike goalwards, but his effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post.
8' Leicester are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
4' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Wolves will take the kick-off.
Samuel Barrott will supervise the game today.
